rationale: ZIN rule (owner, 17 October 2026): all art is new and image-generated; never copy assets from other mods. This overrides the kit's third-party source search, so no external source exists for this reference.

generator.prompt: A single full-body character for a 3D model reference, for a dark painterly fantasy grand-strategy game. Straight front view, the whole figure from head to feet visible and centred with margin on every side, standing on nothing, relaxed A-pose with arms angled about 30 degrees away from the body and legs slightly apart, hands open and empty, fingers separated. He holds no weapon, no shield, no staff and no banner; nothing is attached to the hands. Plain flat uniform light grey (#c8c8c8) background, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground, no scenery, no text, no frame. Clear readable silhouette, no loose cloth streamers, no thin floating parts, armour pieces solid and attached to the body. The figure is a Grave Host revenant: an undead warrior with a gaunt grey skeletal face and faint pale-green glowing eyes, wearing ancient corroded bronze armour and a cracked crested helm over tattered dark burial wrappings that hang close to the body, exposed bony hands. Eerie but solid.
